verdict.rationale: The evidence pack says Fivetran syncs databases with automatic incremental syncs, captures deletes, and offers a soft delete mode. None of it mentions log-based CDC, binlog or WAL reading, or lower load on the source, so the story's core mechanism is unevidenced. Generic incremental syncs and delete capture are adjacent features, not documented log-based replication.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I replicate databases with log-based CDC (binlog/WAL) so I capture updates and deletes without hammering the source
